Find documented loot through the linked item and creature pages. Each source keeps its own results and conditions.

[[Random treasure]] lists the eligible items for each documented chest, remains and bonus-treasure pool, with its value budget and selection rules. For reliable named routes, item pages put recipes, sellers and fixed or specific source records before conditional random finds. [[Items#Recipe_ingredients_by_acquisition|Ingredient acquisition groups]] separate creature drops, gathering and purchases.

The catalog is not exhaustive. A missing result does not mean that a drop is impossible.
